title: Invoice extraction
description: What the LLM must return for one supplier invoice. Values are transcribed from the document as printed; nothing is calculated, corrected or inferred. Money is a decimal string in dollars (converted to integer cents by code, never by the model). Validated in the 'Validate Extraction' Code node; invalid output gets one retry, then needs_review.

supplier_name.description: Name of the business issuing the invoice (the seller), not the customer.

supplier_abn.description: The seller's ABN, 11 digits. Spaces as printed are fine; code strips them.

bill_to_name.description: Name of the customer being billed (the hotel).

invoice_number.description: The supplier's invoice number, exactly as printed, including any prefix. Not the PO number, account number or delivery docket number.

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD. Australian documents write dd/mm/yyyy: 03/08/2026 is 3 August 2026.

due_date.description: Payment due date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if the invoice prints none.

po_number.description: The customer's purchase order number as printed (labels vary: 'Customer PO', 'Your Order No.', 'Order Ref', 'Purchase Order'), or null if none is printed. Never guess or fill one in.

lines.description: Every line item, in document order. Do not include subtotal, GST, total, delivery-docket or terms rows.

supplier_code.description: The supplier's item code/SKU for this line if one is printed, else null.

description.description: Line description as printed, without the supplier code or any tax marker symbol (^ or *).

quantity.description: Quantity as printed (weighed items have decimals, e.g. 2.420).

unit.description: Unit of measure exactly as printed on the line, in lowercase (each, kg, box, carton...). A unit that is part of the quantity text counts ('2.420 kg' gives kg). If the document prints no unit for the line, null; never infer one from the product.

unit_price.description: Price per unit, ex GST, in dollars with two decimals. No currency symbol or thousands separator.

gst_applicable.description: True if GST applies to this line. Read it from the document's own marker (a Tax column showing GST vs FREE, a ^ or * symbol, or a per-line GST amount above 0.00). Do not decide it from what the item is.

line_total.description: Line amount ex GST as printed. Copy it; do not recalculate.

line_gst.description: GST amount for this line if the invoice prints GST per line (a GST column), else null.

subtotal.description: Total ex GST as printed. Copy it; do not recalculate.

gst.description: Total GST as printed, even if it looks wrong. 0.00 if the invoice prints zero GST.

total.description: Total payable including GST, as printed, even if it does not equal subtotal + GST.
